team.title: Team

team.how2: Press "Create invitation link". Xedine does not email it for you.

settings.priceBasisHelp: Locked after your first order, so your history stays comparable.

settings.regulatoryNote: Tax rules change. Enter the rates your accountant confirms — Xedine never assumes them.
settings.cutoffHelp: Late-night orders before this time belong to the previous business day.
settings.branchesBody: Opening a new outlet? Ask for it on the Branch setup page. Xedine approves it first.
settings.receiptSubtitle: Printed on receipts and KOTs. Mushak 6.3 fields — TODO(verify) with your accountant.
settings.binHelp: Business Identification Number — TODO(verify) with your accountant.

settings.packaging: Box and bag cost per order (৳)
settings.packagingHint: What you spend on boxes, bags and cutlery for one delivery order. Leave empty if there is none.
settings.commissionIntro: This helps us show your real profit on each channel.
settings.deleteReasonConfirm: Delete this reason for good? Old records stay, but they will no longer show this reason. To just stop using it, press Deactivate instead.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Xedine is a restaurant app for Bangladesh. This page says, in plain words, what we keep about you and why.

collect.title: What we keep
collect.body: Your account: your name, email address and, if you sign in with a phone, your phone number. Your restaurant's records that you or your staff enter: menu, orders, stock, purchases, staff and settings. Customer names and phone numbers only when the restaurant adds them; offers reach a customer only after they agree.

signIn.title: Signing in with Google or Facebook
signIn.body: If you choose Google or Facebook, we receive only your name, email address and profile picture, to create and open your Xedine account. We do not read your email, contacts, files or posts. Signing in does not let us post as you; posting to your restaurant's Facebook Page happens only if you connect it separately in Settings.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to run Xedine for your restaurant: show your numbers, keep your stock and send the messages you approve. AI helpers read your restaurant's records to answer your questions and draft text; customer phone numbers are left out unless the task needs them.

share.title: Who else sees it
share.body: We do not sell your data and we show no ads. The services that run Xedine store or process it for us: Supabase (database and sign-in), Cloudflare (hosting), AI providers (answering questions), and Telegram, WhatsApp or Facebook only when you use those features. Inside a restaurant, the owner decides who sees what; cost and profit are for the owner and accountant only.

safety.title: Keeping it safe
safety.body: Every restaurant's data is kept apart from every other restaurant's, connections are encrypted, and passwords are never stored in plain text.

keep.title: Keeping and deleting
keep.body: We keep your data while your account is open. Ask us to delete your account and we delete it and your personal data within 30 days, except records the law requires a business to keep.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Write to {email} to ask about your data, get a copy of it or have it deleted.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using Xedine you agree to these simple terms.

service.title: What Xedine is
service.body: A tool to run a restaurant: till, kitchen, stock, menu, customers and reports. Features may change as we improve the app.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Give true details and keep your password and sign-in safe. You are responsible for what is done from your account and by the staff you invite.

data.title: Your restaurant's data
data.body: Your records belong to you. You let us store and process them only to run Xedine for you, as the privacy policy explains.

fair.title: Fair use
fair.body: Don't use Xedine for anything illegal, to message people who did not agree, or to try to reach another restaurant's data.

ai.title: Numbers and AI
ai.body: Numbers come from your own records. Text the AI writes is a suggestion: check it before you act. Anything that reaches people needs your approval, except the social autopilot, which posts by itself only after you switch it on.

price.title: Price
price.body: A paid plan shows its price before you pay. We tell you before any price changes.

warranty.title: No guarantee
warranty.body: We work hard to keep Xedine running and correct, but it is provided as it is. We are not responsible for indirect losses, such as lost profit, from using it.

stop.title: Stopping
stop.body: You can stop at any time and ask us to delete your account. We may close an account that breaks these terms.

law.title: Law
law.body: These terms follow the laws of Bangladesh.

dataDeletion.title: Delete your data
dataDeletion.intro: You can have your Xedine account and the personal data we keep about you deleted at any time.

how.title: How to ask
how.body: Email {email} from the address you sign in with, and write "Delete my account". If you signed in with Facebook or a phone number, tell us the name on your account so we can find it.

facebook.title: If you signed in with Facebook
facebook.body: You can also remove Xedine from Facebook yourself: Facebook → Settings & privacy → Settings → Apps and websites → Xedine → Remove. Then email us as above to delete what Xedine kept.

what.title: What we delete
what.body: Your account, name, email address, phone number and profile picture, and your sign-in links to Google or Facebook. If you own a restaurant on Xedine, its records are deleted too, unless the law requires a business to keep them.

when.title: When
when.body: Within 30 days. We email you when it is done.
